## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector participation (Utilities, Communication, Healthcare leading) and Big Tech/Financials weakness while cyclicals/materials and utilities show strength. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 performers span 5 sectors).  

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; SO referenced in news flow.  
Communication lead: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; TTWO (1W: +5.89% | 1M: -13.04%) RECOVERY.  
Healthcare strong: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND.  

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND.  
Financials lagging: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND.  

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).  

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND; MET (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -4.82%) BELOW TREND; PNC (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials.  

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — note INTU and PYPL show short-term bounces versus weak 1M, a divergence to monitor.  

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION — sector showing internal rotation with negative 1M performance overall (Technology soft on 1M).  

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Weak and dispersed: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth negative (Financials under pressure).  

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive bid intact: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +1.13% | 1M: -0.26%) RECOVERY — healthcare showing relative strength and accumulation.  

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/materials and defensive staples while reducing exposure to large-cap Technology and weak Financial names; monitor short-term recoveries (PYPL, INTU) before adding. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt with mixed leadership — remain selective given major divergences among large caps.  

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — bullish news confirms price action; EQIX (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND — momentum intact; NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/flow-driven.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside; AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND — weak across timeframes; IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price under strain.  

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +3.11% | 1M: +9.77%) — steady; Materials (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +6.54%) — cyclical lift; Energy (1W: +1.68% | 1M: +12.00%) — commodity strength.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -9.60%) — distribution in large caps; Financials (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) — sector-wide weakness.  

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — a decisive break below the recent 1W lows would confirm extended downside.  
NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND — sustained volume above this week’s range would signal follow-through.  
FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — hold higher weekly lows to stay constructive.  

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
FCX (+75): Freeport headline and expanded Grasberg rights; price confirming with FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
(Notes: Other high-sentiment names appear in broader news flow but lacked dual timeframe detail in today's dataset.)  

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PYPL (-60): Legal and CEO-change headlines; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — sentiment bearish but price shows short-term bounce (divergence).  
INTU (-45): Price-target cut; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — bearish sentiment vs. 1W pop (watch for follow-through).  
MDLZ (-50): Distribution/operations headlines; MDLZ (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +6.67%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price still confirming, monitor for reversal.  

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt as breadth is constructive (Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive).  
NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL CORRECTION, INTU RECOVERY, CAT CORRECTION) plus bearish headlines on PYPL/INTU — watch for trend confirmation before extending positions.
